$comment: Registered exceptions to Gate 129's skill-board-loop-concurrency-claim
check, enforced by
.github/scripts/verify-skill-board-loop-concurrency-claim.py at
pull-request time -- see
specs/089-skill-example-drift/contracts/skill-drift-gate.md.
The one claim this gate owns is
.claude/skills/spec-cross-reference/SKILL.md's Over-rated example's
assertion about board-loop.yml's concurrency configuration (job range,
ordinary group, directed group, cancel-in-progress). A PR that changes
board-loop.yml's concurrency shape and cannot also edit .claude/ (the
implement-stage case, FR-013) records a waiver entry here instead of
being stuck.
Every entry is STALE-CHECKED in both directions, the same as
single-home-waivers.json and stage-invariant-waivers.json: an entry
whose {property, job} pair matches no divergence Gate 129 currently
computes fails the gate as stale, so a waiver cannot outlive the skill
update it was waiting on. A divergence with no matching entry fails the
gate as blocking, unwaived drift.
No waivers are expected to exist at merge time for this feature's own
introduction (spec 089's own Assumptions section) -- board-loop.yml on
main already matches the skill's Over-rated example.

waivers.reason: specs/115-board-loop-self-merge adds board-loop.yml's `merge` job to the ordinary wing-commander-board-loop group. The implement stage may not write .claude/, so the spec-cross-reference skill's Over-rated example still lists the old job range. Tracked on the maintenance backlog #889 (the line 'update the spec-cross-reference skill's board-loop job range for the merge job'). Remove this waiver when that line is done.
